facts.text: The North Texas Promise program requires students to be Texas residents graduating from a Texas high school with a total family income of $100,000 or less.

sources.title: North Texas Promise Program - Financial Aid
sources.quote: Be a Texas resident graduating from a Texas high school. Have a total family income of $100,000 or less* Rank in Top 25% of high school class or be eligible for Federal Pell Grant.
